facts_raw.Program: 清华 x-lab × Shell GameChanger 未来能源创变者加速计划
facts_raw.Focus: 未来能源、硬科技、能源转型
facts_raw.Stage: Pre-A 及以前；公司成立5年内
facts_raw.Funding / Support: 优胜奖金；符合条件项目有机会获得种子资金、合作开发和其他投资渠道
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: 2–3支优胜团队评选；种子资金需进一步满足条件/决策
facts_raw.Non-dilutive: Prize component yes; seed capital terms separate
facts_raw.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Prize/Opportunity Public / Exact Amounts Not Public
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No, but unregistered team must plan to incorporate within 6 months
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: China-wide recruitment; company ≤5 years, Pre-A or earlier; complete IP ownership required
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 能源转型突破性硬科技；公司成立5年内、Pre-A及以前；完整知识产权；未注册团队6个月内成立公司计划。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 能源企业合作意向或自有小型中试产线加分；技术创新、领域契合、商业化潜力、团队执行力。
facts_raw.Format: 一年专项加速 + 产业验证
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 一年加速；含清华 x-lab 导师/场地/季度评审及壳牌场景合作，需能参加约定线下/项目活动。
facts_raw.International Founder: 主要中国全国招募；非清华背景可。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 公司/项目介绍、创新点与竞争优势、核心技术/产品、BP；一位联络人代表团队报名。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；Climate / Energy；阶段以 Pre-A 及以前；公司成立5年内 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 不以 venture-scale 为目标、创始团队无法全职投入、或仅希望获得短期曝光的项目
facts_raw.Notes: 仅2–3支优胜团队；清华导师 + Shell 全球专家 + 真实产业场景，适合能源/硬科技。

facts.Program: Tsinghua x-lab × Shell GameChanger Future Energy Accelerator
facts.Foundshore Verdict: Depends on sector and stage fit.
facts.Focus: Future energy, deeptech and the energy transition.
facts.Stage: Pre-Series A; incorporated within five years
facts.Funding / Support: Prizes for winners; eligible projects may access seed funding, joint development or other investment opportunities.
facts.Funding Trigger: Two or three winning teams are selected; seed funding requires further eligibility checks and a separate decision.
facts.Non-dilutive: Prize component yes; seed capital terms separate
facts.Capital Disclosure Status: Verified — Prize/Opportunity Public / Exact Amounts Not Public
facts.Company Required at Application: No, but unregistered team must plan to incorporate within 6 months
facts.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: China-wide recruitment; company ≤5 years, Pre-A or earlier; complete IP ownership required
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Breakthrough energy-transition technology; incorporated within five years and pre-Series A or earlier, with full IP rights. Unincorporated teams must plan to form a company within six months.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Energy-company collaboration or a small pilot production line is an advantage, alongside technical innovation, sector fit, commercialization potential and execution.
facts.Format: One year of focused acceleration and industrial validation.
facts.On-site / Attendance: One year of acceleration with Tsinghua x-lab mentors, facilities, quarterly reviews and Shell collaboration. Participation in agreed project and in-person activities is required.
facts.International Founder: Primarily China-wide recruitment; Tsinghua affiliation is not required.
facts.Visa / Relocation: Not applicable to this China-based program.
facts.Application Materials: Company or project summary, innovation, competitive advantage, core technology or product and business plan. One contact applies for the team.
facts.Public Contact Route: Telephone or WeChat: 18813060610, plus the published email contact for the 2026 intake.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; Climate / Energy; primarily at the Pre-Series A; incorporated within five years stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Projects without venture-scale ambitions, founders unable to commit full-time, or teams seeking short-term exposure only.
facts.Notes: Two or three winning teams, supported by Tsinghua mentors, Shell experts and industrial use cases; focused on energy and deeptech.
